parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS gateway_request_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
        $3::BIGINT AS client_id,
        $4::TEXT AS channel,
        $5::TEXT AS external_conversation_id,
        $6::TEXT AS external_message_id,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS sender,
        $8::TEXT AS message_type,
        NULLIF($9::TEXT, '') AS message_text,
        $10::JSONB AS attachments,
        $11::JSONB AS normalized_payload,
        $12::JSONB AS raw_payload,
        $13::TEXT AS language
),

inserted_message AS (
    INSERT INTO inbound_channel_messages (
        gateway_request_id,
        clinic_id,
        client_id,
        channel,
        external_conversation_id,
        external_message_id,
        sender,
        message_type,
        message_text,
        attachments,
        normalized_payload,
        raw_payload,
        language,
        processing_status
    )
    SELECT
        request.gateway_request_id,
        request.clinic_id,
        request.client_id,
        request.channel,
        request.external_conversation_id,
        request.external_message_id,
        request.sender,
        request.message_type,
        request.message_text,
        request.attachments,
        request.normalized_payload,
        request.raw_payload,
        request.language,
        'forwarded'
    FROM request_data request
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        channel,
        external_message_id
    )
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING *
),

selected_message AS (
    SELECT
        inserted.*,
        FALSE AS duplicate_message
    FROM inserted_message inserted

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        existing.*,
        TRUE AS duplicate_message
    FROM inbound_channel_messages existing
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON existing.clinic_id =
           request.clinic_id
       AND existing.channel =
           request.channel
       AND existing.external_message_id =
           request.external_message_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted_message
    )

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'inbound_message_registered' AS result,
    selected.id AS inbound_channel_message_id,
    selected.duplicate_message
FROM selected_message selected;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS inbound_message_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS gateway_request_id,
        $3::JSONB AS orchestrator_response,
        $4::BOOLEAN AS execution_success
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE inbound_channel_messages message
    SET
        processing_status = CASE
            WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
                THEN 'processed'
            ELSE 'failed'
        END,
        orchestrator_response =
            request.orchestrator_response,
        processed_at = NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE message.id =
          request.inbound_message_id
    RETURNING message.*
),

updated_request AS (
    UPDATE channel_gateway_requests gateway
    SET
        processing_status = CASE
            WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
                THEN 'processed'
            ELSE 'failed'
        END,
        result =
            request.orchestrator_response,
        processed_at = NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE gateway.id =
          request.gateway_request_id
    RETURNING gateway.*
)

SELECT
    request.execution_success AS success,
    CASE
        WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
            THEN 'inbound_gateway_event_processed'
        ELSE 'inbound_gateway_event_failed'
    END AS result,
    request.inbound_message_id,
    request.gateway_request_id,
    request.orchestrator_response
FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS gateway_request_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
        $3::BIGINT AS client_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS provider_name,
        $5::TEXT AS channel,
        $6::TEXT AS external_event_id,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS external_message_id,
        $8::JSONB AS normalized_event,
        $9::JSONB AS raw_event
),

inserted_callback AS (
    INSERT INTO provider_callback_events (
        gateway_request_id,
        clinic_id,
        client_id,
        provider_name,
        channel,
        callback_type,
        external_event_id,
        external_message_id,
        normalized_event,
        raw_event,
        processing_status
    )
    SELECT
        request.gateway_request_id,
        request.clinic_id,
        request.client_id,
        request.provider_name,
        request.channel,
        'delivery_status',
        request.external_event_id,
        request.external_message_id,
        request.normalized_event,
        request.raw_event,
        'forwarded'
    FROM request_data request
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        provider_name,
        external_event_id
    )
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING *
),

selected_callback AS (
    SELECT
        inserted.*,
        FALSE AS duplicate_callback
    FROM inserted_callback inserted

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        existing.*,
        TRUE AS duplicate_callback
    FROM provider_callback_events existing
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON existing.clinic_id =
           request.clinic_id
       AND existing.provider_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
           request.provider_name
       AND existing.external_event_id =
           request.external_event_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted_callback
    )

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'delivery_callback_registered' AS result,
    selected.id AS provider_callback_event_id,
    selected.duplicate_callback
FROM selected_callback selected;

updated_callback AS (
